contracts.name: relay.bank
contracts.description: Set one physical relay channel, 1 through 6; reports commanded state.

usage.before: Acquire the board's shared resource. Channels are numbered 1 through 6; RC direction names depend on the physical wiring.
usage.read_result: Read channel, on and commanded_mask. contact_feedback=false means physical contacts are not instrumented.

contracts.name: device.outputs.batch
contracts.description: Apply a locally timed sequence of relay, RGB and buzzer frames.

usage.before: Acquire the same board resource as relay.bank. Existing firmware limits are 1–32 frames, 3,072 input bytes and 60,000 ms total waits; all steps validate before any I/O.
usage.read_result: Read steps_completed, relay_masks, applied_at_ms and final output state. An uncertain result must be reconciled by operation ID without replaying the batch.

contracts.name: serial.rs485
contracts.description: Exchange raw bytes on the board's automatic-direction RS-485 UART.

usage.before: Acquire the shared board resource; provide the device's serial settings. Payload is lower-case hexadecimal. No Modbus validation is implied.
usage.read_result: Inspect tx_completed, rx_hex and timed_out. A partial or uncertain transmission must not be replayed.

contracts.name: sound.buzzer
contracts.description: Play one buzzer tone using the existing board driver.

usage.before: Acquire the shared board resource. The existing driver accepts 100–10000 Hz and 1–5000 ms.
usage.read_result: Successful output reports the requested frequency and duration.

contracts.name: light.rgb
contracts.description: Set the board RGB LED to three 8-bit channel values.

usage.before: Acquire the shared board resource. Each component is 0–255.
usage.read_result: Successful output reports commanded red, green and blue.
